notes:
Congratulations on reaching your first Singularity!

The key to progressing quickly during the first few Singularity Events (SEs) is to use your crystals and tokens to upgrade your Alpha/Energy output as much as possible. This is going to be the main driver of progression until around SE4/5.
path: B1
B1,  B3

notes: It is a good idea to start levelling up your G-Point multiplier (at the bottom of the G-Corporation menu) in SE4. This will drive your progression for the next few Singularities.

SE5 and the next few Singularities will be slower than anything up to this point. Put a few levels into the G-Point multiplier (at the bottom of the G-Corporation menu) if you haven't already done so and focus on levelling up your Companions.
